title.zh: 手机片段：可点击可键盘操作的进度条
title.en: Phone clips: a position rail you can seek with

highlights.zh: 手机片段播放器新增由真实音频驱动的进度条：点击或左右键 seek、两端自动 clamp、切片段与从零重播自动归零。
highlights.en: The phone clip player gains a rail driven by the element's own audio: press or arrow keys to seek, both ends clamp, and it returns to zero on a clip switch and on a restart from the top.

highlights.zh: 8 条判据覆盖映射、NaN/0 时长守卫、两端 clamp、点击 seek、键盘步进、切片段与重播归零。typecheck 0 错。
highlights.en: Eight criteria cover the mapping, the NaN/zero-duration guard, both clamps, press-to-seek, keyboard steps, and the resets on clip switch and restart. Typecheck is clean.
